entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The mightiest kami on Kamigawa, an eight-headed serpent that guarded the barrier between the physical and spirit worlds and is killed by Kyodai and Michiko.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where the Kami War is fought.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: A lord who raided the Spirit World and tore out O-Kagachi's heart, starting the Kami War.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: O-Kagachi's scion and daughter, its stolen divinity, who is freed, takes the name Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi with Michiko.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A twenty-year war provoked by Konda's theft of O-Kagachi's heart.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Konda's daughter who frees the Taken One, binds her power with Kyodai and helps defeat O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A rogue samurai who holds Michiko, steals the Taken One from Eiganjo and helps release her.

entities.name: All-Consuming Oni of Chaos
entities.description: Hidetsugu's master, easily defeated by O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre shaman whose master O-Kagachi defeats.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Lord Konda's stronghold, reduced almost completely to ruin by O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: The guardian dragon of Konda's realm, ripped in half by O-Kagachi and forced to flee.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A kami whose power Toshiro Umezawa uses to teleport into Konda's sanctum.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: The forest where the Taken One is released from stone.

entities.name: Kakuriyo
entities.description: The spirit realm, whose barrier with the mortal realm broke down after O-Kagachi's death.

entities.name: Utsushiyo
entities.description: The mortal realm that merges with the spirit realm.

events.summary: Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, casting it as a stone disk.
events.quote: he tore out O-Kagachi's "heart," its divinity

events.summary: Enraged, O-Kagachi moves the other kami to strike the mortal world, beginning the Kami War.
In the twentieth year, O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
events.quote: It also defeated Hidetsugu's master, the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily.

events.summary: O-Kagachi descends on Eiganjo Castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins the castle.
events.quote: One of O-Kagachi's heads caught Yosei in its jaws and ripped him in half

events.summary: Toshiro Umezawa teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One during the chaos.
events.quote: He stole the Taken One from the pedestal

events.summary: O-Kagachi senses the Taken One's absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.
events.quote: leaving in its wake the ruins of Konda's kingdom

events.summary: Michiko and Toshi release the Taken One in Jukai Forest; she takes the name Kyodai and binds her power with Michiko.
events.quote: took the name Kyodai and bound her power with Princess Michiko Konda

events.summary: Kyodai and Michiko immobilize and defeat O-Kagachi, biting off its remaining heads.
events.quote: bit off O-Kagachi's remaining heads, then cast the limp body aside

events.summary: Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil; the war ends.
events.quote: The war ended soon after the Serpent's defeat

events.summary: O-Kagachi's death breaks down the barrier, merging the spirit and mortal realms.
events.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

relations.note: Stole its heart, provoking the Kami War.
relations.quote: when Lord Takeshi Konda raided the Spirit World

relations.note: Its scion and daughter; once its divinity.

relations.quote: O-Kagachi succumbed to the divine power that had once been its own greatest strength

relations.note: Shared power and fought O-Kagachi together.
relations.quote: Michiko and Kyodai worked together to immobilize O-Kagachi's heads one by one
the other the daughter of a king
the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily
